gauntlet.intent: T4 main-ladder baseline #2: genuinely ASYMMETRIC per-side ROE with an escalation rule, per the tier spec's example pairing verbatim -- BLUE starts friendlyRoe=WeaponsTight fleet-wide and only earns WeaponsFree per-domain via mission.triggers firing on first contact (asw-hunt-roe frees p-3c-orion-update-iii-2023/s-120-papanikolis-type-214hn/a-19-gotland-2002 on first Subsurface detection; aaw-intercept-roe frees f-230-norfolk-type-23-duke/k-11-stockholm-spica-iii-1986/eurofighter-typhoon on first Air detection), while RED runs opposingRoe=WeaponsFree from tick 0 with no trigger and no escalation of its own -- it never needed one. This differs from gauntlet-forge-20260727-1455-t4-c3 (both sides WeaponsTight baseline, BLUE dual-trigger escalation only) and from gauntlet-forge-20260727-1455-t4-c4 (a single-side domain split narrated around one static ROE flag, explicitly not using the trigger mechanic) -- this scenario is the tier's clean side-vs-side asymmetric-ROE-plus-escalation baseline. Deliberately, no ASuW trigger exists for BLUE's surface-domain radar contact on pk-368-vasily-bykov-pr-22160 (c-s2-7): any BLUE attempt to fire on RED's surface units before/outside the ASW or AAW windows stays WeaponsTight-denied per PolicyEvaluator.EvaluateRoe, giving a real, persistent denial floor across the full 24-tick budget independent of the two escalation windows. Blue ASW group is subsurface-heavy (P-3C Orion sonobuoy MPA + two SSKs) hunting RED's SSN/SSK/SSBN trio (pla-971-akula-i-improved-shchuka-b, pl-677-lada-b-585-sankt-peterburg-2011, plarb-955a-borei-ii-borey-a -- the roster's flagged high-value ASW target); BLUE AAW group (FFG + corvette radar cross-cue + Eurofighter CAP) intercepts RED's two-ship raid (mig-31-foxhound, su-30sm-flanker-g-2019).
gauntlet.oracle: BLUE's ASW group is expected to remain WeaponsTight-denied until its first Subsurface Unknown->Detected transition fires asw-hunt-roe, after which it may register ASW kills against pla-971-akula-i-improved-shchuka-b / pl-677-lada-b-585-sankt-peterburg-2011 / plarb-955a-borei-ii-borey-a. BLUE's AAW group is likewise denied until its first Air Unknown->Detected transition fires aaw-intercept-roe, after which it may kill mig-31-foxhound and/or su-30sm-flanker-g-2019. BLUE's surface-domain contact on pk-368-vasily-bykov-pr-22160 has no covering trigger and is expected to generate WeaponsTight denials for the entire run. RED (WeaponsFree, unrestrained throughout) is expected to convert some of its own high-Pd radar detections (c-s2-8, c-s2-9, c-s2-10) into kills against BLUE, but only BLUE is scored here (expect.side=BLUE), consistent with every other scenario/candidate in this run.
